senses.gloss: --the second form of Parabrahmam. Vi. I. 2. १५, १८.
--a son of भृगु. वा. ६५. ८७.
--a special rite in the sacrifice. वा. ६५. ५६.
--a nephew of हिरण्यकशिपु. M. 6. २६.
--(ety.) one of the ten लक्षणस् of the ब्राह्मणस्. वा. ५९. १३८.
--a son of Vapu. वा. १०. ३६; Br. II. 9. ६१.
--a son of भृगु. वा. ६५. ८७.
--individuality as opposed to समष्टि or Brahmam. वा. 3. १०.
--the difficulties and dangers of a kingdom; the king must avert them. M. २२०. २५.
--the place where sages expound the Vedic lore. Br. III. २१. ५२.
(I)--a son of यातुधान and father of निरा- nanda. Br. III. 7. ८९ and ९६.
(II)--one of the five sons of ऊर्द्ध्वदृष्टि and father of शरभ. Br. III. 7. २०५.

(III)--the tiger, said to have eaten Garga's cow;
1: M. २०. १०.
its skin, the dress of शिव.
2: Ib. २१७. 5; २५९. 6.
(IV)--a snake with the sun in आवणि and पुरट्टाशि. वा. ५२. ११.
(VI)--the राक्षस residing in the sun's chariot in the भाद्रपद month. Vi. II. १०. १०.
(VII)--the राक्षस presiding over the month of Nabhasya. भा. XII. ११. ३८; Br. II. २३. ११.

--born of Hari and Pulaha; a वानरजाति and son of जाम्बवान्;
1: Br. III. 7. १७६, ३०४, ३१९; ५१. 9.
could be killed as wild animals.
2: Ib. IV. 6. ५०; २९. ४१.
[page३-348+ २४]
--wife of जाम्बवत्; mother of जाम्बवती. Br. III. 7. ३०१.
--a son of भृगु; a deva. Br. III. 1. ८९.
--a hunter who attained permanent fame. भा. X. ७२. २१.
--of भार्गवगोत्र. M. १९५. २७.
--a son of मृत्यु. वा. १०. ४१.
(II)--a mind-born son of ब्रह्मा in the २१स्त् Kalpa. वा. २१. ४७; ३१. ४१.
--all pervadingness from apavarga; from that comes पुरुष. वा. १३. २३.
--a god of सुतार group. Br. IV. 1. ९०.
--one of the ten branches of the सुपार group of devas. वा. १००. ९४.

--from the hairs of the head of प्रजापति. ety. ahi, the vilest of creatures; Pannaga. ety. creeping on the ground; sarpa, from escaping or fleeting nature; all have their abode in the earth under the sun and moon; out of anger came विष or poison; then airy beings were created; चूटस्, पिशाचस् from eating flesh, Gandharvas sucking cows. वा. 9. ३४-40.
--is शिव. Br. II. २७. ९९.

(I)--an अम्शावतार of विष्णु; also known as Dvai- पायन and कृष्ण; son of पराशर and वासवी (सत्यवती) in द्वापर yuga. Father of शुक; appointed by his mother, he begot three sons on his brother's wife being childless- धृतराष्ट्र, पाण्डु and Vidura.
1: भा. I. 2. 4; 4. १४-15; IX. २२. २२-25; XII. 6. ३६; III. 5. १९-20; M. १५. 8; १८०. ६४; Br. III. १०. ७९-80; १३. ७७.
Rearranged the Vedas into four parts, and taught each of them to four respective pupils--Paila, वैशम्पायन, Jaimini and Sumantu. Re- arranged इतिहास-Pura1n2as also; composed the भारत for स्त्रीशूद्र-dvijabandhus; composed also the भागवत and taught it to his son शुक, having heard it from नारद.
2: भा. XII. 6. ४९-53; I. 4. १६-25; 7. 1-8; II. 9. ४४; III. 5. १० and १२; XII. 4. ४२; १३. १९; Br. I. 1. २५; II. ३१. २८; ३३. ३२-3; ३४. ११-12; III. १७. २९५.
When he felt a mental dissatisfaction, नारद met him and was praised. Asked as to the reason for his uneasiness, नारद emphasised devotion to Hari as the means of release and proceeded to narrate the story of his previous birth. When the sage left व्यास retired to his hermitage शम्या- प्रास on the सरस्वती and meditated on the Lord who appeared before him with माया depending on him. Learnt [page३-350+ ३७] devotion as the means of ending सम्सार।
3: भा. I. 4. ३०-33; chh. 5 and 6 (whole); 7. 1-4;
One of युधिष्- ठिर's party on a visit to भीष्म; was a Purohita at कृष्ण's sacrifice at कुरुक्षेत्र; told the history of Citraketu to शुक who bowed to him.
4: Ib. I. 8. ४६; 9. 2; X. ९०. ४६[2]; VI. १४. 9; VII. 1. 5.
Heard श्रुतिगीता from नारायण. Faith in क्रियायोग; a siddha.
5: Ib. X. ८७. ४७-8; XI. २७. 2; VI. १५. १२.
Taught लोमहर्षण about the future of the world and its history.
6: M. ५०. ७२.
An incarnation of the Lord in every द्वापर;
7: Ib. ५३. 9.
took a vow of silence and fasting for १२ years after which he wandered for food but could not get any in Benares; when he was about to curse the city, शिव and उमा took the guise of householders and offered him rich food. So he blessed it.
8: Ib. १८५. १७-38.
A तीर्थ in his honour.
9: Ib. १९१. ४१; २०३. १४.
(II)--a sage of the eighth manvantara. भा. VIII. १३. १५; Vi. III. 2. १७.

--near दृषद्वति;
1: Br. III. १३. ६९, ८०.
in दीपेश्वर, a तीर्थम् of the नर्मदा sacred to व्यास.
2: M. १९१. ३८-42.
--the sacred lake near शिव lake. Br. III. १३. ५२; वा. ७७. ५१.

--daughters of सविता;
1: भा. VI. १८. 1; III. १२. ४४.
three in number.
2: वा. ६४. १९.
